description: Combined certification for configurable orchestration, nested managed agents, the live agent tree, Worker verification, and Settings buffering.

prerequisites.label: Validate and execute the documented live Run A PowerShell commands
Build public workspace types used by extension and webview tests

tracks.label: Worker isolation, Apply, and orphan recovery
Agent runtime policy, registry, capacity, and recovery
Spawn, lifecycle, mailbox, result, and cancellation routing
Awaited terminal and real OS process-tree cleanup
Worker Apply verification and parent completion gate
Strict native provider and lifecycle protocol
Compact agent task surfaces, transcript controls, and history regressions
Settings buffered-edit and managed-agent configuration regressions

rows.requirement: ExtensionState/updateSettings expose the exact bounded orchestration fields and defaults agreed with the backend.
Every child freezes contextManifest.orchestration ancestry, delegationPolicy, and limits; legacy omissions recover with frozen legacy defaults.

probes.label: frozen ancestry and effective limits contract
patterns: freezes ancestry and effective limits while retaining legacy manifests

probes.label: legacy omission recovery with frozen defaults
patterns: recovers a legacy orchestration omission with frozen legacy defaults

probes.label: frozen delegation policy and role timeout reload
patterns: rehydrates a child with its frozen delegation policy and role timeout despite changed settings

sourceProbes.label: orchestration schema binds ancestry policy and limits

rows.requirement: Live/list projections expose depth, maxDepth, delegationPolicy, effectiveLimits, and terminal stopReason.

probes.label: bounded public projection schema
patterns: parses a bounded nested registry projection without raw manifests or report bodies

probes.label: provider projects durable nested fields and stop reason
patterns: projects the durable nested registry into a bounded reload-safe webview contract

probes.label: compact task strip consumes projected hierarchy and terminal state
patterns: opens active and nested tasks with the exact task id
keeps status readable without relying on dot color

rows.requirement: Explicit-request versus proactive delegation policy is enforced and reload-stable.

probes.label: per-task policy can narrow but not widen

rows.requirement: Validated role-specific timeouts survive reload and produce one deterministic terminal result.
Output, token, and cost limits stop the root tree deterministically and report the effective stop reason.
Authorized children may spawn descendants only within configured depth and narrowed authority.

probes.label: authorized read-only nesting and frozen depth
patterns: allows read-only descendants within frozen depth while denying depth, delegation, and Worker widening

probes.label: authorized Worker nesting with exact scope narrowing
patterns: allows a Worker to layer one nested Worker only within its frozen directory and exact-file scope

probes.label: layered Worker checkout ownership
patterns: layers a nested Worker worktree through its owning parent before the root checkout

rows.requirement: One root-wide capacity pool bounds every descendant and releases slots on terminal transitions.

probes.label: root-wide descendant capacity
patterns: counts descendants against one root cap without serializing another root

probes.label: terminal and queued slot release
patterns: cleans capacity, queued waiters, and run registrations exactly once

probes.label: atomic concurrent admission

rows.requirement: Cancel, interrupt, and close have deterministic descendant/subtree semantics.

probes.label: recursive descendant cancellation ordering
patterns: cancels descendants deepest-first and distinguishes direct-child from deeper target causes

probes.label: immediate cancellation admission race
patterns: registers children before publishing running state so immediate cancellation is not lost

probes.label: bottom-up retained close semantics

rows.requirement: Mailbox events and terminal results route once to the owning parent with durable cursors.

probes.label: durable per-recipient cursors
patterns: tracks per-recipient delivery and acknowledgement cursors durably

probes.label: wait versus automatic injection claim
patterns: claims a wait_agent result before automatic result injection can duplicate it

probes.label: managed-child parent-control wait
patterns: keeps a registered managed child waiting for immediate-parent control without active descendants

rows.requirement: Descendant results, messages, waits, and controls use the immediate owning parent and atomic result claims.

probes.label: immediate-parent descendant result routing
patterns: allocates stable nested identity and routes a grandchild result only to its immediate parent mailbox

probes.label: authorized descendant-only controls
patterns: cancels descendants deepest-first and distinguishes direct-child from deeper target causes

probes.label: concurrent mailbox claim is exactly once
patterns: grants exactly one durable owner to concurrent mailbox consumers

rows.requirement: Live parent steering is acknowledged only after durable child persistence, and delivered-but-unacknowledged steering is recovered on retained follow-up.

probes.label: durable live steering acknowledgement
patterns: acknowledges live steering only after the child reports durable persistence

probes.label: delivered but unacknowledged follow-up recovery

rows.requirement: report_progress is a bounded, auto-approved sub-agent-only capability that durably routes once to the immediate parent without result-claim interference.

probes.label: root and missing-parent rejection

probes.label: root and managed-child tool catalog boundary
patterns: keeps an idle primary Code task limited to delegation entry points
omits orchestration tools from a legacy managed child without delegation authority

probes.label: strict bounded provider and registry contract

probes.label: registry active-record recovery
patterns: recovers active records once while preserving completed records

probes.label: orphaned Worker recovery
patterns: recovers partial changes from an orphaned active worktree after reload

probes.label: Apply decision reload

rows.requirement: Reload reconstructs nested ownership, budgets, mailbox routing, and orphan cleanup without flattening.

probes.label: nested tree reload

probes.label: nested orphan cleanup

rows.requirement: fork_turns inheritance is frozen, credential-free, digest-checked, and authority-narrowed.

rows.requirement: A managed parent cannot complete with active descendants or unowned descendant terminal results.

probes.label: durable Apply transition and verification

probes.label: pre-terminal completion recheck

probes.label: layered parent and root verification ownership
patterns: layers Worker verification ownership at each immediate parent

probes.label: same pre-terminal verification recheck

probes.label: compact attention and overflow actions

keeps group cancellation in a compact overflow menu
keeps command approval behind an explicit compact attention flow

probes.label: reload-safe bounded task state

keeps loading and error state to one compact line

rows.requirement: Managed-agent settings bind to cachedState and unrelated live updates cannot erase unsaved edits.

probes.label: cached-state callback

probes.label: Task coalesces concurrent aborts

probes.label: bounded termination discovery

probes.label: real OS process-tree removal

rows.requirement: The downgrade-compatible global-state history mirror is byte-bounded, root-only, newest-first, and cannot mutate authoritative history.

probes.label: bounded root-only compatibility mirror
patterns: keeps a bounded root-only downgrade mirror without managed-child payloads

probes.label: newest roots remain within byte budget
patterns: keeps the newest roots that fit and never exceeds the byte budget

probes.label: authoritative history is immutable
patterns: does not mutate authoritative history while truncating compatibility text

probes.label: provider writes only the compact compatibility mirror
patterns: writes only a bounded root-only downgrade mirror to globalState

integrationPending.requirement: Real conversation: explicit-only delegation accepts genuine user authorization and rejects model-inferred/protocol-shaped authorization across reload.
integrationPending.reason: Requires the real conversation/provider boundary to distinguish direct human provenance from generated or replayed records.

integrationPending.requirement: Real VS Code host: nested spawn, root-wide capacity, descendant cancellation, crash/reload, immediate-parent mailbox routing, and orphan cleanup.
integrationPending.reason: Requires extension-host restart and real managed child processes; unit mocks cannot establish process ownership or crash recovery.

integrationPending.requirement: Real provider: role timeout and root output/token/cost exhaustion stop all descendants once with accurate usage and cost.
integrationPending.reason: Requires billable provider usage/stream termination and wall-clock enforcement that deterministic offline tests must not simulate as proof.

integrationPending.requirement: Real VS Code host: Worker Apply transitions required -> pending, completion is rejected, parent command satisfies verification, then completion succeeds across reload.
integrationPending.reason: Requires the real extension host, terminal ownership, filesystem worktree, UI Apply action, reload, and completion transition.

integrationPending.requirement: Real webview: compact nested task rows update status and attention, open the exact child without disturbing siblings, retain overflow actions, and preserve Settings unsaved edits across background refreshes.
integrationPending.reason: Requires the live webview/extension message loop and user-visible timing; jsdom does not prove host/webview convergence.

integrationPending.requirement: Real extension-host termination cancels non-cooperative descendant HTTP streams and process trees without leaking capacity.
integrationPending.reason: Requires OS process ownership and provider abort behavior beyond the in-memory runner seams.

integrationPending.requirement: Multiple real extension hosts/windows cannot corrupt shared agent-control state or double-claim mailbox results.
integrationPending.reason: Requires multi-process writers against the real global-storage filesystem; the in-process store singleton cannot prove this.

integrationPending.requirement: Real extension-host global state remains below its configured compatibility budget during managed-agent churn and reload.
integrationPending.reason: The deterministic compaction tests prove helper behavior only; real VS Code storage serialization and multi-window reload require dedicated host instrumentation.
